scopes.cm:campaigns:read: Read campaign state and consistent views.
scopes.cm:campaigns:write: Create campaigns and edit unaccepted campaign drafts.
scopes.cm:campaigns:approve: Approve a campaign plan or scope revision.
scopes.cm:campaigns:close: Close a campaign after its outstanding obligations are accounted for.
scopes.cm:cards:read: Read cards, readiness, dependencies and accepted work packets.
scopes.cm:cards:write: Create cards and edit unaccepted card drafts, dependencies and metadata.
scopes.cm:cards:approve: Approve a card revision and its acceptance criteria or execution grant.
scopes.cm:cards:advance: Request a card state transition; applicable evidence and state guards still apply.
scopes.cm:reviews:read: Read review cards, rounds and stable finding histories.
scopes.cm:reviews:start: Admit one formal review round within its declared cap.
scopes.cm:reviews:record: Collect a native review result; supplied labels do not establish reviewer identity.
scopes.cm:reviews:adjudicate: Resolve a disputed finding or review disagreement with an attributed decision.
scopes.cm:sessions:read: Read managed session status, declared purpose, limits and native receipts.
scopes.cm:sessions:start: Admit a managed worker or helper under an accepted card and remaining limits.
scopes.cm:sessions:stop: Request checkpoint and termination; a request is not confirmation that a session stopped.
scopes.cm:spend:read: Read usage, API-equivalent cost, actual charges and their coverage separately.
scopes.cm:spend:record: Collect deduplicated native usage; arbitrary submitted amounts are not authoritative.
scopes.cm:journal:read: Read linked decisions and their alternatives, evidence and preconditions.
scopes.cm:journal:append: Append a decision or a superseding correction; never overwrite history.
scopes.cm:escalations:read: Read escalations without acknowledging, answering or closing them.
scopes.cm:escalations:open: Open or update a deduplicated escalation linked to its cause.
scopes.cm:escalations:resolve: Answer and close an escalation with an explicit disposition; closure alone grants nothing else.
scopes.cm:evidence:read: Read accepted evidence and its source bindings.
scopes.cm:evidence:submit: Submit an attributed report or artifact; submission does not certify native provenance or acceptance.
scopes.cm:evidence:collect: Fetch and bind native evidence from a recorded run or task.
scopes.cm:backups:create: Create a consistent snapshot without changing campaign authority.
scopes.cm:backups:read: Download a snapshot and its verification manifest.
scopes.cm:recovery:inspect: Inspect recovery state, missing history and unknown operations.
scopes.cm:recovery:reconcile: Collect positive recovery evidence and apply safe reconciliation.
scopes.cm:recovery:accept-exposure: Explicitly accept a named unresolved exposure; never infer acceptance from silence.
scopes.cm:releases:prepare: Prepare a versioned release operation from applicable reviewed inputs.
scopes.cm:releases:approve: Approve the exact release inputs under the campaign policy.
scopes.cm:releases:publish: Publish through the qualified native release path; source and artifact guards still apply.
scopes.cm:deployments:apply: Ship an accepted immutable artifact to an authorized target.
scopes.cm:deployments:rollback: Run an accepted rollback to the named compatible artifact/configuration.
scopes.cm:tests:run: Start a declared integration or smoke test within its task and target bounds.
scopes.cm:experiments:run: Start a declared experiment with its protocol, limits and cleanup obligations.
scopes.cm:credentials:revoke: Revoke a credential identifier; cannot mint tokens or read signing/provider secrets.
scopes.cm:drivers:write: Register, replace or remove a driver within an accepted assignment.
scopes.cm:watches:write: Create or change a watch; expiry is not successful completion.
scopes.cm:exceptions:approve: Approve a specifically bounded exception; no blanket bypass of other checks.
scopes.cm:observations:record: Collect source-bound observations without replacing a judgement.
scopes.cm:campaigns:reconcile: Request collection/reconciliation of existing campaign operations; never redispatch an unknown effect.
scopes.cm:ideas:write: Admit or update idea records and outcomes under campaign phase/evidence guards.
scopes.cm:reviews:raise-cap: Explicitly increase a review card round cap with a linked escalation disposition; never reset round history.
scopes.cm:lanes:read: Read lane inventory, health projections, queue order and history; nested resources require their read scopes.
scopes.cm:lanes:write: Create, pause, resume or retire a lane; immutable bindings and outstanding-work guards still apply.
scopes.cm:lanes:edit-queue: Attach, detach, move or reorder non-flight cards; never override claims, unknown effects or accepted work.
scopes.cm:tracks:read: Read work-track definitions, footprints, limits and routing.
scopes.cm:tracks:write: Create or edit work-track definitions and explicitly reclassify card tracks within accepted constraints.
scopes.cm:tracks:route: Change the ordered primary and fallback lanes and automatic-fallback policy for a track.
scopes.cm:executors:read: Read executor configuration, source-bound health and meter freshness.
scopes.cm:executors:configure: Configure or pause an executor; cannot assert healthy observations or erase admission holds.
scopes.cm:executors:probe: Request a qualified capability probe; paid canaries need the ordinary test and session scopes.
scopes.cm:artifacts:read: Read native artifact bindings, observed state and attention reasons.
scopes.cm:artifacts:write: Bind or rebind artifacts to durable cards and tracks without rewriting native evidence.
scopes.cm:handoffs:acknowledge: Acknowledge a consistent handoff snapshot; acknowledgement grants no execution authority.
